text: dean of st. patrick’s, dublin.
zh: 圣院长帕特里克，都柏林。
chunks: dean of st.
patrick’s, dublin.

text: Before he quitted Redriff, he left the custody of the following papers in my hands, with the liberty to dispose of them as I should think fit.
zh: 在他离开雷德利夫之前，他把以下文件交给我保管，我可以自由地按照我认为合适的方式处置它们。
chunks: Before he quitted Redriff, he left the custody
of the following papers
in my hands, with the liberty
to dispose of them
as I should think fit.

text: But I was resolved to fit the work as much as possible to the general capacity of readers.
zh: 但我决心让这部作品尽可能适合读者的一般能力。
chunks: But I was resolved
to fit the work as much as possible to the general capacity of readers.

text: Likewise in the account of the academy of projectors, and several passages of my discourse to my master _Houyhnhnm_, you have either omitted some material circumstances, or minced or changed them in such a manner, that I do hardly know my own work.
chunks: Likewise in the account of the academy of projectors,
and several passages of my discourse to my master _Houyhnhnm_,
you have either omitted some material circumstances,
or minced or changed them in such a manner,
that I do hardly know my own work.

text: And indeed to avoid so monstrous and detestable a sight was one principal motive of my retirement hither.
chunks: And indeed
to avoid so monstrous and detestable a sight was one principal motive of my retirement hither.

text: I find likewise that the writers of those bundles are not agreed among themselves; for some of them will not allow me to be the author of my own travels; and others make me author of books to which I am wholly a stranger.
zh: 我同样发现这些包的作者之间意见不一致。因为他们中的一些人不允许我成为我自己的旅行的作者；还有一些人让我写了一些我完全陌生的书。
chunks: I find likewise that the writers
of those bundles are not agreed among themselves; for some
of them will not allow me to be the author of my own travels;
and others make me author of books
to which I am wholly a stranger.

text: And I observe, when any _Yahoo_ comes from London out of curiosity to visit me at my house, we neither of us are able to deliver our conceptions in a manner intelligible to the other.
zh: 我观察到，当任何_雅虎_出于好奇从伦敦来到我家拜访我时，我们双方都无法以对方可以理解的方式传达我们的想法。
chunks: And I observe, when any _Yahoo_ comes
from London out of curiosity to visit me
at my house, we neither
of us are able to deliver our conceptions
in a manner intelligible to the other.

text: I should never have attempted so absurd a project as that of reforming the _Yahoo_ race in this kingdom; but I have now done with all such visionary schemes for ever.
zh: 我永远不应该尝试像改革这个王国的_雅虎_种族这样荒谬的计划；但我现在已经永远放弃了所有这些有远见的计划。
chunks: I should never have attempted
so absurd a project as that
of reforming the _Yahoo_ race in this kingdom;
but I have now done
with all such visionary schemes for ever.

text: My father had a small estate in Nottinghamshire; I was the third of five sons.
zh: 我父亲在诺丁汉郡拥有一座小庄园。我是五个儿子中的第三个。
chunks: My father had a small estate
in Nottinghamshire;
I was the third
of five sons.

text: When I came back I resolved to settle in London; to which Mr. Bates, my master, encouraged me, and by him I was recommended to several patients.
zh: 当我回来后，我决定在伦敦定居。我的导师贝茨先生鼓励了我，他还把我推荐给了几位病人。
chunks: When I came back I resolved
to settle in London; to which Mr. Bates,
my master, encouraged me,
and by him I was recommended
to several patients.

text: My hours of leisure I spent in reading the best authors, ancient and modern, being always provided with a good number of books; and when I was ashore, in observing the manners and dispositions of the people, as well as learning their language; wherein I had a great facility, by the strength of my memory.
chunks: My hours of leisure I spent in reading the best authors,
ancient and modern, being always provided with a good number of books;
and when I was ashore, in observing the manners
and dispositions of the people, as well as learning their language;
wherein I had a great facility, by the strength of my memory.

text: We set sail from Bristol, May 4, 1699, and our voyage was at first very prosperous.
zh: 1699年5月4日，我们从布里斯托尔起航，航行一开始非常顺利。
chunks: We set sail
from Bristol,
and our voyage was
at first very prosperous.

text: We rowed, by my computation, about three leagues, till we were able to work no longer, being already spent with labour while we were in the ship.
zh: 据我计算，我们划了大约三里格，直到我们不能再工作为止，因为我们在船上的时候就已经劳累过度了。
chunks: We rowed, by my computation,
about three leagues, till we were able
to work no longer,
being already spent with labour
while we were in the ship.

text: The declivity was so small, that I walked near a mile before I got to the shore, which I conjectured was about eight o’clock in the evening.
zh: 坡度很小，我走了近一英里才到达岸边，我猜当时是晚上八点左右。
chunks: The declivity was so small,
that I walked near a mile
before I got to the shore,
which I conjectured was
about eight o’clock in the evening.

text: I likewise felt several slender ligatures across my body, from my arm-pits to my thighs.
zh: 我同样感觉到身体上有几条细长的结扎线，从腋窝到大腿。
chunks: I likewise felt several slender ligatures across my body,
from my arm-pits
to my thighs.

text: In the mean time, I felt at least forty more of the same kind (as I conjectured) following the first.
zh: 与此同时，继第一个之后，我至少感觉到了四十个类似的感觉（正如我推测的）。
chunks: In the mean time,
I felt
at least forty more
of the same kind
(as I conjectured) following the first.

text: I might be a match for the greatest army they could bring against me, if they were all of the same size with him that I saw.
zh: 如果他们的规模和我看到的他一样大的话，我可能会与他们所能派出的最强大的军队相抗衡。
chunks: I might be a match
for the greatest army they could bring against me,
if they were all
of the same size
with him that I saw.

text: He descended from the stage, and commanded that several ladders should be applied to my sides, on which above a hundred of the inhabitants mounted and walked towards my mouth, laden with baskets full of meat, which had been provided and sent thither by the king’s orders, upon the first intelligence he received of me.
chunks: He descended from the stage, and commanded that several ladders should be applied to my sides, on which
above a hundred of the inhabitants mounted
and walked towards my mouth, laden with baskets full of meat,
which had been provided and sent thither by the king’s orders,
upon the first intelligence he received of me.

text: They supplied me as fast as they could, showing a thousand marks of wonder and astonishment at my bulk and appetite.
zh: 他们以最快的速度给我提供食物，对我的块头和胃口表现出千百种惊奇和惊讶。
chunks: They supplied me as fast
as they could,
showing a thousand marks
of wonder and astonishment
at my bulk and appetite.

text: I confess I was often tempted, while they were passing backwards and forwards on my body, to seize forty or fifty of the first that came in my reach, and dash them against the ground.
zh: 我承认，当它们在我身上来回穿梭时，我常常忍不住想抓住四十或五十个最先到达我手边的东西，然后把它们摔到地上。
chunks: I confess I was often tempted,
while they were passing backwards and forwards on my body,
to seize forty or fifty
of the first that came in my reach,
and dash them against the ground.

text: I answered in few words, but to no purpose, and made a sign with my hand that was loose, putting it to the other (but over his excellency’s head for fear of hurting him or his train) and then to my own head and body, to signify that I desired my liberty.
chunks: I answered in few words, but to no purpose,
and made a sign with my hand that was loose, putting it to the other
(but over his excellency’s head for fear of hurting him
or his train) and then to my own head and body, to signify
that I desired my liberty.

text: But before this, they had daubed my face and both my hands with a sort of ointment, very pleasant to the smell, which, in a few minutes, removed all the smart of their arrows.
zh: 但在此之前，他们在我的脸和双手上涂抹了一种气味非常宜人的药膏，几分钟之内，他们的箭伤就消失了。
chunks: But before this, they had daubed my face
and both my hands with a sort
of ointment, very pleasant to the smell, which,
in a few minutes,
removed all the smart of their arrows.

text: This resolution perhaps may appear very bold and dangerous, and I am confident would not be imitated by any prince in Europe on the like occasion.
zh: 这个决议或许显得非常大胆和危险，我相信欧洲任何一位王子在类似场合都不会效仿。
chunks: This resolution perhaps may appear very bold
and dangerous,
and I am confident would not be imitated
by any prince in Europe
on the like occasion.

text: Five hundred carpenters and engineers were immediately set at work to prepare the greatest engine they had.
chunks: Five hundred carpenters
and engineers were immediately set at work to prepare the greatest engine they had.

text: Eighty poles, each of one foot high, were erected for this purpose, and very strong cords, of the bigness of packthread, were fastened by hooks to many bandages, which the workmen had girt round my neck, my hands, my body, and my legs.
zh: 为此目的，竖起了八十根柱子，每根一英尺高，用钩子将非常坚固的绳子（粗细的包装线）固定在许多绷带上，工人们把这些绷带绑在我的脖子、我的手、我的身体和我的腿上。
chunks: Eighty poles, each of one foot high, were erected for this purpose,
and very strong cords, of the bigness
of packthread, were fastened by hooks to many bandages,
which the workmen had girt round my neck,
my hands, my body, and my legs.

text: The next morning at sunrise we continued our march, and arrived within two hundred yards of the city gates about noon.
zh: 第二天一早，日出时分，我们继续行军，中午时分抵达距城门不到两百码的地方。
chunks: The next morning
at sunrise we continued our march,
and arrived within two hundred yards
of the city gates
about noon.

text: On each side of the gate was a small window, not above six inches from the ground: into that on the left side, the king’s smith conveyed fourscore and eleven chains, like those that hang to a lady’s watch in Europe, and almost as large, which were locked to my left leg with six-and-thirty padlocks.
chunks: On each side of the gate was a small window,
not above six inches from the ground: into that
on the left side, the king’s smith conveyed fourscore
and eleven chains, like those that hang to a lady’s watch in Europe, and almost
as large, which were locked to my left leg with six-and-thirty padlocks.

text: When the workmen found it was impossible for me to break loose, they cut all the strings that bound me; whereupon I rose up, with as melancholy a disposition as ever I had in my life.
zh: 当工人们发现我无法挣脱时，就把束缚我的绳子全部剪掉了。于是我站了起来，心情一如既往地忧郁。
chunks: When the workmen found it was impossible
for me to break loose, they cut all the strings
that bound me; whereupon I rose up,
with as melancholy a disposition
as ever I had in my life.

text: Learned men appointed to teach the author their language.
zh: 有学问的人被任命教作者他们的语言。
chunks: Learned men appointed
to teach the author their language.

text: The country around appeared like a continued garden, and the enclosed fields, which were generally forty feet square, resembled so many beds of flowers.
zh: 周围的乡村看起来就像一个连绵不断的花园，围起来的田野一般有四十英尺见方，就像许多花坛。
chunks: The country
around appeared like a continued garden,
and the enclosed fields,
which were generally forty feet square,
resembled so many beds of flowers.

text: The best expedient I could think of, was to creep into my house, which I accordingly did; and shutting the gate after me, I went as far as the length of my chain would suffer, and discharged my body of that uneasy load.
zh: 我能想到的最好的权宜之计就是溜进我的房子，我因此就这么做了。然后关上门，我走到了我的锁链所能承受的范围内，卸下了我身体里那份不安的负担。
chunks: The best expedient I could think of,
was to creep into my house, which I accordingly did;
and shutting the gate after me,
I went as far as the length of my chain would suffer,
and discharged my body of that uneasy load.

text: When he alighted, he surveyed me round with great admiration; but kept beyond the length of my chain.
zh: 当他下车时，他满怀钦佩地打量着我。但保持在我链子的长度之外。
chunks: When he alighted,
he surveyed me round
with great admiration; but kept
beyond the length
of my chain.

text: He was then past his prime, being twenty-eight years and three quarters old, of which he had reigned about seven in great felicity, and generally victorious.
chunks: He was then past his prime,
being twenty-eight years and three quarters old,
of which he had reigned
about seven in great felicity,
and generally victorious.

text: His voice was shrill, but very clear and articulate; and I could distinctly hear it when I stood up.
zh: 他的声音很尖，但非常清晰、清晰。当我站起来时我可以清楚地听到它。
chunks: His voice was shrill,
but very clear
and articulate;
and I could distinctly hear it
when I stood up.

text: I took them all in my right hand, put five of them into my coat-pocket; and as to the sixth, I made a countenance as if I would eat him alive.
zh: 我把它们全部拿在右手里，把其中的五个放进了我的外套口袋里；至于第六个，我做出一副要把他活活吃掉的表情。
chunks: I took them all in my right hand,
put five of them
into my coat-pocket; and as
to the sixth, I made a countenance
as if I would eat him alive.

text: He directed that those who had already beheld me should return home, and not presume to come within fifty yards of my house, without license from the court; whereby the secretaries of state got considerable fees.
zh: 他指示那些已经看到我的人应该回家，未经法庭许可，不得擅自进入我家五十码范围内；国务卿由此获得可观的费用。
chunks: He directed that those
who had already beheld me should return home,
and not presume to come within fifty yards
of my house, without license from the court; whereby the secretaries
of state got considerable fees.

text: An establishment was also made of six hundred persons to be my domestics, who had board-wages allowed for their maintenance, and tents built for them very conveniently on each side of my door.
zh: 还有一个由六百人组成的机构作为我的佣人，他们有膳食工资用于维持生活，并且在我门的两侧非常方便地为他们搭建了帐篷。
chunks: An establishment was also made
of six hundred persons to be my domestics,
who had board-wages allowed for their maintenance, and tents built
for them very conveniently
on each side of my door.

text: And he advised me to “acquire, by my patience and discreet behaviour, the good opinion of himself and his subjects.
zh: 他建议我“通过我的耐心和谨慎的行为，获得他和他的臣民的好感。
chunks: And he advised me
to “acquire, by my patience
and discreet behaviour,
the good opinion of himself
and his subjects.

text: In one of my fobs there was a silver watch, and in the other a small quantity of gold in a purse.
chunks: In one
of my fobs there was a silver watch,
and in the other a small quantity
of gold
in a purse.

text: In his right waistcoat-pocket we found a prodigious bundle of white thin substances, folded one over another, about the bigness of three men, tied with a strong cable, and marked with black figures; which we humbly conceive to be writings, every letter almost half as large as the palm of our hands.
chunks: In his right waistcoat-pocket we found a prodigious bundle
of white thin substances, folded one over another, about the bigness of three men,
tied with a strong cable, and marked with black figures;
which we humbly conceive to be writings, every letter almost half
as large as the palm of our hands.

text: One of them was covered, and seemed all of a piece: but at the upper end of the other there appeared a white round substance, about twice the bigness of our heads.
zh: 其中一个被遮住了，看起来是一个整体，但在另一个的上端出现了一个白色的圆形物质，大约是我们脑袋大小的两倍。
chunks: One of them was covered,
and seemed all of a piece:
but at the upper end
of the other there appeared a white round substance,
about twice the bigness of our heads.

text: We directed him to draw out whatever was at the end of that chain; which appeared to be a globe, half silver, and half of some transparent metal; for, on the transparent side, we saw certain strange figures circularly drawn, and thought we could touch them, till we found our fingers stopped by the lucid substance.
chunks: We directed him to draw out whatever was at the end
of that chain; which appeared to be a globe, half silver, and half
of some transparent metal; for, on the transparent side,
we saw certain strange figures circularly drawn, and thought we could touch them,
till we found our fingers stopped by the lucid substance.

text: Signed and sealed on the fourth day of the eighty-ninth moon of your majesty’s auspicious reign.
zh: 陛下吉祥年八十九月初四签字印章。
chunks: Signed and sealed
on the fourth day of the eighty-ninth moon of your majesty’s auspicious reign.

text: In the mean time he ordered three thousand of his choicest troops (who then attended him) to surround me at a distance, with their bows and arrows just ready to discharge; but I did not observe it, for my eyes were wholly fixed upon his majesty.
chunks: In the mean time he ordered three thousand
of his choicest troops (who then attended him)
to surround me at a distance, with their bows
and arrows just ready to discharge; but I did not observe it,
for my eyes were wholly fixed upon his majesty.

text: The astonishment here was much greater than at the sight of my scimitar.
zh: 这里的惊讶比看到我的弯刀还要大得多。
chunks: The astonishment here was much greater
than at the sight of my scimitar.

text: My scimitar, pistols, and pouch, were conveyed in carriages to his majesty’s stores; but the rest of my goods were returned me.
zh: 我的弯刀、手枪和袋子都用马车运到国王陛下的仓库。但我其余的货物都退还给我了。
chunks: My scimitar, pistols,
and pouch, were conveyed in carriages
to his majesty’s stores;
but the rest
of my goods were returned me.

text: I took all possible methods to cultivate this favourable disposition.
zh: 我想尽一切办法来培养这种良好的性格。
chunks: I took all possible methods
to cultivate this favourable disposition.

text: The emperor had a mind one day to entertain me with several of the country shows, wherein they exceed all nations I have known, both for dexterity and magnificence.
zh: 有一天，皇帝想用几场乡村表演来招待我，这些表演无论是灵巧还是华丽，都超过了我所知道的所有国家。
chunks: The emperor had a mind one day
to entertain me with several
of the country shows,
wherein they exceed all nations I have known,
both for dexterity and magnificence.

text: When a great office is vacant, either by death or disgrace (which often happens) five or six of those candidates petition the emperor to entertain his majesty and the court with a dance on the rope; and whoever jumps the highest, without falling, succeeds in the office.
chunks: When a great office is vacant, either by death or disgrace
(which often happens) five or six
of those candidates petition the emperor to entertain his majesty
and the court with a dance on the rope; and whoever jumps the highest,
without falling, succeeds in the office.

text: These diversions are often attended with fatal accidents, whereof great numbers are on record.
zh: 这些改道经常引发致命事故，有记录的事故数量很多。
chunks: These diversions are often attended
with fatal accidents,
whereof great numbers are
on record.

text: The emperor lays on the table three fine silken threads of six inches long; one is blue, the other red, and the third green.
chunks: The emperor lays
on the table three fine silken threads
of six inches long;
one is blue, the other red,
and the third green.

text: Sometimes the emperor holds one end of the stick, and his first minister the other; sometimes the minister has it entirely to himself.
zh: 有时，皇帝握着棍子的一端，而大臣则握着另一端。有时部长完全可以独享这一切。
chunks: Sometimes the emperor holds one end
of the stick,
and his first minister the other;
sometimes the minister has it entirely
to himself.

text: When I had finished my work, I desired the emperor to let a troop of his best horses twenty-four in number, come and exercise upon this plain.
zh: 当我完成工作后，我请求皇帝派一支他最好的马匹二十四匹到这片平原来锻炼。
chunks: When I had finished my work,
I desired the emperor to let a troop
of his best horses twenty-four
in number, come and exercise
upon this plain.

text: Two days after this adventure, the emperor, having ordered that part of his army which quarters in and about his metropolis, to be in readiness, took a fancy of diverting himself in a very singular manner.
zh: 这次冒险两天后，皇帝下令驻扎在他的大都市及其周围的部分军队做好准备，并想以一种非常奇特的方式转移自己的注意力。
chunks: Two days after this adventure, the emperor, having ordered
that part of his army
which quarters in and about his metropolis,
to be in readiness, took a fancy of diverting himself
in a very singular manner.

text: Bolgolam, who was pleased, without any provocation, to be my mortal enemy.
zh: 博尔戈兰，在没有任何挑衅的情况下，很高兴成为我的死敌。
chunks: Bolgolam,
who was pleased,
without any provocation,
to be my mortal enemy.

text: But because the reader may be curious to have some idea of the style and manner of expression peculiar to that people, as well as to know the article upon which I recovered my liberty, I have made a translation of the whole instrument, word for word, as near as I was able, which I here offer to the public.
chunks: But because the reader may be curious to have some idea
of the style and manner of expression peculiar
to that people, as well as to know the article
upon which I recovered my liberty, I have made a translation of the whole instrument,
word for word, as near as I was able, which I here offer to the public.

text: 5th, If an express requires extraordinary despatch, the man-mountain shall be obliged to carry, in his pocket, the messenger and horse a six days journey, once in every moon, and return the said messenger back (if so required) safe to our imperial presence.
chunks: 5th, If an express requires extraordinary despatch, the man-mountain shall be obliged
to carry, in his pocket, the messenger
and horse a six days journey, once in every moon,
and return the said messenger back
(if so required) safe to our imperial presence.

text: Belfaborac, the twelfth day of the ninety-first moon of our reign.
zh: 贝尔法博拉克，我们统治时期九十月的第十二天。
chunks: Belfaborac,
the twelfth day
of the ninety-first moon
of our reign.

text: Mildendo, the metropolis of Lilliput, described, together with the emperor’s palace.
zh: 米尔登多是小人国的大都市，与皇帝的宫殿一起被描述。
chunks: Mildendo,
the metropolis
of Lilliput, described,
together with the emperor’s palace.

text: The wall which encompassed it is two feet and a half high, and at least eleven inches broad, so that a coach and horses may be driven very safely round it; and it is flanked with strong towers at ten feet distance.
zh: 包围它的墙有两英尺半高，至少十一英寸宽，因此马车和马匹可以非常安全地绕着它行驶。它的两侧有十英尺远的坚固塔楼。
chunks: The wall which encompassed it is two feet
and a half high, and at least eleven inches broad,
so that a coach
and horses may be driven very safely round it;
and it is flanked with strong towers at ten feet distance.

text: The two great streets, which run across and divide it into four quarters, are five feet wide.
zh: 两条宽五英尺的宽阔的街道将这里分成四个部分。
chunks: The two great streets,
which run across
and divide it
into four quarters,
are five feet wide.

text: It is enclosed by a wall of two feet high, and twenty feet distance from the buildings.
zh: 它被一堵两英尺高的墙围起来，距离建筑物二十英尺。
chunks: It is enclosed
by a wall
of two feet high,
and twenty feet distance
from the buildings.

text: Of these trees I made two stools, each about three feet high, and strong enough to bear my weight.
zh: 我用这些树做了两个凳子，每个凳子高约三英尺，坚固到足以承受我的重量。
chunks: Of these trees I made two stools,
each about three feet high,
and strong enough
to bear my weight.

text: Her imperial majesty was pleased to smile very graciously upon me, and gave me out of the window her hand to kiss.
zh: 女王陛下很高兴地对我微笑，并把她的手伸出窗外亲吻我。
chunks: Her imperial majesty was pleased
to smile very graciously
upon me, and gave me
out of the window her hand
